verdict.rationale: Unity documents extensive public scripting APIs, editor extensibility, CLI tooling, and command-line automation, which together let an AI-native user script and drive the product programmatically; the official MCP server and CLI further support agentic automation. However, there is no standard REST/OpenAPI spec (probes return 404 for openapi.json), and no llms.txt/docs-md machine-readable interface at the docs.unity3d.com root. missing for 10: a discoverable REST/OpenAPI-style public API spec, machine-readable docs (llms.txt/docs.md returning 404), independent hands-on confirmation of API completeness for AI-driven workflows.
